card.name: Use of an alternative ingredient or method
card.fires_on: Forms of 'use' (used, using, use) and similar verbs like 'work' or 'chosen' where a material, diluent, concentration or method is being picked or swapped in. Often follows 'is', 'if', or 'alternatively'.

modes.label: Used after a condition
modes.description: The word 'used' ends a clause about which liquid or concentration is applied.
modes.example: Some settling may occur and the dispersion may appear cloudy if water is<< used>>.

modes.label: Choosing an alternative
modes.description: A verb such as 'use' or 'using' introduces a substitute or option in recipes and preparation steps.

modes.description: Words like 'chosen' or 'work' describe something picked or something that will serve the purpose.
